edits.target: - Before emitting code, audit the planned calls against the latest turn and full conversation: for each new request or accepted preference, identify its intended item, domain, relation, and schema-supported argument, then verify that a planned call includes it. Do not reprocess unchanged domains. Use only a listed, compatible cache result for refinement; if none exists and mandatory inputs are available, search instead of filtering. After the audit, use `print("No planning needed")` only if no requested action or constraint remains unsatisfied by valid cached results.
edits.content: - Before emitting code, resolve the latest turn against the preceding assistant question and all pending requests. List one action for each requested domain, item, and explicit flight leg; compare its criteria with compatible listed cache entries and check each mandatory-input slot against the full conversation. For each action, use a valid cached result if it already satisfies the request; otherwise retrieve a compatible result and refine only unmet criteria, search if no compatible result exists and required inputs are explicit, or ask for missing inputs. Decide independently for each action so a blocked domain does not suppress ready ones. Verify that every new constraint has a schema-supported argument and every flight leg has the stated route and departure date in the planned call. Use `print("No planning needed")` only when no requested action or constraint remains unsatisfied by valid cached results.

- For a requested flight search, `departure_date` is mandatory even when the route and other preferences are known. An arrival-time preference, trip purpose, or group-booking description does not supply it. If no compatible cached result covers the request and the date is absent, ask for the departure date with `seek_information`; do not make a partial flight call or use `print("No planning needed").

edits.target: - A cached base result does not satisfy a newly requested constraint, and a result for one domain does not satisfy a request for another. Use `print("No planning needed")` only when relevant, valid cached results already satisfy every requested action and constraint.

Use `print("No planning needed")` only when relevant, valid cached results already satisfy every requested action and constraint.
